main_measure.name: pooled slope of excess 10-bar return on forecast, profile bars, non-overlapping grid
main_measure.threshold: slope t >= 2 (with top-minus-bottom > 0) confirms; t <= -2 rejects; at least 300 grid cases and 100 distinct grid days

supporting_check.name: mean excess return, top third minus bottom third by forecast

decided_by: Minimum count not reached: 174 grid cases inside the profile (300 needed) and 66 distinct grid days (100 needed).
reading: The coin's mean 10-bar return is the mean over all its non-overlapping grid cases in all windows (profile or not), the profile is bars with regime 'unknown' where near_high is recorded, the thirds are the n//3 lowest and highest grid cases by forecast (stable sort), and the expected side is the sign of the forecast rebuilt from raw component values (post-pipeline values where a window lacks a full standardise history).
